title: Proposed merger between Cengage Learning and McGraw-Hill Education

timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC requested further information from the parties
Former provisional date for announcement of findings (21 November) is delayed to allow the parties more time to provide additional information.
ACCC received further information from the parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
ACCC requested further information from the parties.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
ACCC is awaiting information from the parties. Former provisional date for announcement of ACCC’s findings (12 March 2020) is delayed. ACCC will announce a proposed decision date in due course.
ACCC discontinued its public review after Cengage and McGraw-Hill advised that the merger would not be proceeding.

body_sections.Summary: The parties are both active in education publishing and the transaction involves the combination of Cengage's and McGraw-Hill's global publishing businesses.
